title: West Africa Fund of Funds Financial Modelling
description: We advised a global impact fund manager to set up a target $50 million blended capital structure for a working capital debt fund. The facility intends to raise substantial capital from international impact investors and development partners.
mandate: Financial modelling for a blended working-capital debt structure.
challenge: Design a structure to attract impact investors and development partners.
outputs: A proposed blended capital structure with a target size of $50 million.
outcomes: The $50 million is a fundraising target, not a reported amount raised.

title: Global Impact Fund
description: We advised a global impact fund on the ideation, design, financial modelling and initial testing of pan-African blended capital facility to provide working capital instruments for companies in Agribusiness, Renewable Energy and Healthcare in East and West Africa. This included potential currency catalytic first loss shares.
challenge: Connect working-capital instruments with agribusiness, renewable energy and healthcare companies.
approach: Ideation, design, financial modelling and initial testing, including potential currency catalytic first-loss shares.
outputs: Initial facility design and financial modelling.
outcomes: No final capital raised or investment outcomes are reported in the source material.

title: African Angel Academy & Accra Angels
description: The African Angel Academy trained 900+ angel investors across Africa, including at the Accra Angels Networks in Ghana. We are part of the expert trainers, notably on non-tech / SME / SGB type of investments, syndication courses and other fundamentals of Angel Investing.
challenge: Build practical investor capability for African SMEs and early-stage enterprises.
approach: Expert instruction in non-tech / SME / SGB investments and syndication.
outputs: Contributions to the Academy’s investor education.
outcomes: The source reports 900+ investors trained by the African Angel Academy overall; this is not an Asime-only participant count.

title: Private Credit for Capital Allocators
description: We advise various investment committees of capital allocators targeting emerging markets and Africa. We provide recommendations on private credit, sovereign debt and other credit products. Our team has deep experience in derivatives, exotic products and credit risk solutions across Europe and Africa.
mandate: Investment committee advice on credit products.
challenge: Evaluate emerging-market and African credit opportunities.
approach: Recommendations on private credit, sovereign debt and other credit products.
outcomes: Investment performance and client-specific outcomes are not publicly disclosed.

title: Executive Training and Capacity Building
description: ANDE - Aspen Investment Manager Training held in Accra, Ghana. Lead trainer for the week long executive training delivered on behalf of ANDE West Africa.
mandate: Lead trainer for Investment Manager Training in Accra.
approach: A week-long executive training programme delivered on behalf of ANDE West Africa.
outputs: Investment-management training delivered in Accra, Ghana.
outcomes: Programme delivery is documented; post-training investment outcomes are not supplied.

title: Sovereign Wealth Fund - Africa Market Entry
description: We presented the African investment landscape and opportunities to Middle Eastern audiences in partnership with HEC Qatar, Qatar Universities. This included case studies of the European vs. African vs. Middle Eastern tech landscape and market development strategies for returns and impact.
client: Middle Eastern audiences; HEC Qatar and Qatar universities
mandate: Present the African investment landscape and market-entry opportunities.
challenge: Build understanding of African markets among Middle Eastern investment audiences.
approach: Comparative case studies across European, African and Middle Eastern markets.
outputs: Investment landscape presentations and market-development perspectives.
outcomes: No subsequent allocation or transaction result is reported.
